newsitem.title: USA: Zomax acquires software replication firm.
newsitem.headline: Zomax acquires software replication firm.

text.p: Zomax Optical Media Inc said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of Benchmark Media Services Inc a Plymouth, Minn.-based software replication firm.
The purchase price for Benchmark's outstanding capital stock will range from $0 to $1.25 million, payable February 1, 1998, and will be based on revenues generated in 1997 by Benchmar, Zomax said.
Privately-held Benchmark had calendar year 1996 revenues of about $10 million.
Zomax Optical Media Inc is a manufacturer and producer of CD-ROM, CD Interactive, CD Video, CD Audio, Floppy Disc and Audio Cassette replication services.
